metadata.title: feat(observability): store token claims in observability spans
metadata.author: mitica

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes # _(optional: add issue number if you opened one)_

---

## 📝 Summary
Adds an **opt-in** setting to store safe JWT claims (sub, iss, aud, iat, exp, nbf, jti) in observability trace and span attributes. When `OBSERVABILITY_STORE_TOKEN_CLAIMS=true`, claims are read from the Bearer token or from `request.state.token_claims` (if set by auth middleware) and written into the existing `attributes` JSON on `observability_traces` and `observability_spans` under keys `token.sub`, `token.iss`, etc. This allows linking tool/resource invocations to the authenticated user (e.g. filtering by `token.sub`) without new DB columns or storing secrets. Disabled by default.

commits.message:
feat(observability): optional storage of JWT claims in trace/span attributes

When OBSERVABILITY_STORE_TOKEN_CLAIMS is enabled, safe JWT claims (sub, iss,
aud, iat, exp, nbf, jti) are extracted from the Bearer token or from
request.state.token_claims (if set by auth middleware) and stored in the
existing attributes JSON on observability_traces and observability_spans
under keys token.sub, token.iss, etc. This allows linking tool/resource
invocations to the authenticated user (e.g. token.sub as user id) without
adding new columns or storing secrets.

- config: add observability_store_token_claims setting (default False)
- observability_service: add current_token_claims ContextVar; start_trace
  accepts optional token_claims and merges into trace attributes;
  start_span merges current_token_claims into span attributes
- observability_middleware: extract safe claims from request; pass to
  start_trace and set context for spans; clear context in finally
- .env.example: document OBSERVABILITY_STORE_TOKEN_CLAIMS

Signed-off-by: Dumitru C <canteadumitru@gmail.com>
